description: This file defines a PHP class 'wsdl' that parses and handles WSDL (Web Services Description Language) files for a SOAP web service client. It includes methods for fetching, parsing, serializing, and describing WSDL documents, and manages structures such as messages, port types, bindings, and services.

classes.name: wsdl
classes.description: A class for parsing, managing, and serializing WSDL files for SOAP web service clients. It handles document fetching from URL or file, XML parsing of WSDL components, and provides methods for constructing SOAP messages based on WSDL definitions.

methods.name: fetchWSDL
methods.description: Fetches the WSDL document from URL or file and initiates parsing.

methods.name: parseWSDL
methods.description: Parses the WSDL XML document, extracting schemas, messages, port types, bindings, and services.

methods.name: start_element
methods.description: XML start element handler for parsing WSDL components.

methods.name: end_element
methods.description: XML end element handler, finalizing schema parsing.

methods.name: character_data
methods.description: Handles character data within XML elements during parsing.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets HTTP authentication credentials, if needed.

methods.name: getBindingData
methods.description: Retrieves data associated with a specific binding.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Returns a list of available operations for a port, optionally filtered by port name and binding type.

methods.name: getOperationData
methods.description: Returns detailed data necessary to invoke a specific operation.

methods.name: getOperationDataForSoapAction
methods.description: Finds operation info based on SOAPAction header and binding type.

methods.name: getTypeDef
methods.description: Retrieves type definition info for a given type name and namespace.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the WSDL object into XML for debugging or inspection.

methods.name: webDescription
methods.description: Generates an HTML documentation page describing the web service's operations.

methods.name: serializeRPCParameters
methods.description: Serializes parameters for a method call based on WSDL definitions, supporting RPC style.

methods.name: serializeParameters
methods.description: Legacy method for serializing parameters, deprecated.

methods.name: serializeType
methods.description: Serializes a PHP value into XML according to a WSDL type definition.

methods.name: serializeType
methods.description: Serializes a PHP value into XML according to its WSDL type, handling various schema types and SOAP-specific namespaces, with support for complex, array, scalar, and special types like Map and boolean.

methods.name: serializeComplexTypeAttributes
methods.description: Serializes attributes for a complexType based on type definitions and provided values, including handling inheritance and default values.

methods.name: serializeComplexTypeElements
methods.description: Serializes the child elements of a complexType, including those inherited via extensions, respecting minOccurs, nillable, and array cardinality.

methods.name: addComplexType
methods.description: Adds a new complexType to the WSDL schemas, handling expansion of QNames and incorporation of elements, attributes, and restrictions.

methods.name: addSimpleType
methods.description: Adds a new simpleType to the WSDL schemas, supporting base restriction types and enumeration values.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds an element declaration to the WSDL types schema.

methods.name: addOperation
methods.description: Registers an operation (method) with the WSDL, constructing request and response types for document style, and adding corresponding messages and binding data.
